stations.title: Classes section
stations.text: Four things in one long line of commas.

captions: Kofi wants new students to know what to bring to their first class.
It is all in one line of commas, so the towel gets missed.
You turn three lines into lists: bulleted, numbered, and one inside another.
The towel is its own item on a checklist, and it gets packed.
Same words from Kofi. Now each set of things is a real list.
